text:
1. When compared with the earlier promise, the apparent difference becomes smaller.
2. Isaac is the child of the covenant.
3. Isaac is the one through whom the nations are to be blessed.
4. In this scene, the earlier promise is turned into a test.
5. The scene turns on the single word *hineni*.
6. *Hineni* means "here I am."
7. Abraham says *hineni* three times.
8. Abraham says *hineni* once to God, once to Isaac, and once to the angel.
9. The word *hineni* carries a different meaning each time Abraham says it.
10. Each time Abraham says *hineni*, it costs him more.
11. The language of presence is also the language of something else, which the passage cuts off before naming.
